desc: Prove formally that every connected remaining Snowflake Tree is characterized by a center and neighboring intermediate vertices, with each intermediate using only neighbors other than the center as leaves.
Derive the fixed-center formula \(1+(y+1)\cdot\#\{v\in N(c):\deg(v)-1\ge y\}\), including why choosing all eligible intermediates is optimal.
Design and implement the \(O(N\log N)\) per-center descending-sort algorithm.
Check edge cases such as paths, stars, \(x=1\), \(y=1\), and centers whose neighbors cannot support any positive \(y\).
Implement fast input/output and verify integer bounds for \(N\le3\cdot10^5\).
